tameablefoxes.config.foxTamingItems.desc: Change or add the items required to tame a fox.
tameablefoxes.config.foxBreedingItems.de: Change or add the items required to breed a fox.
tameablefoxes.config.itemsRestrictedToPi: Prevents foxes from picking up any items listed here in their mouth.
tameablefoxes.config.foxesAttackWithOwne: If true, foxes will attack the mobs owner hits.
tameablefoxes.config.foxesTameDirectly.d: If false, foxes can only be tamed by breeding them.
tameablefoxes.config.foxesCanIgnoreMobGr: If true, foxes will still pick items even if /gamerule mobGriefing set to false.
tameablefoxes.config.foxesTrustOnBorn.de: If true, when two foxed are bred, the baby will directly trust you and be tamed.
tameablefoxes.config.untamedFoxesCanBeTe: If true, untamed foxes will follow you when you hold taming/breeding items of Foxes.
tameablefoxes.config.untamedWolvesAttack: If false, wolves will no longer attack any foxes that are tamed.
